scenario.topic: Decide on the rules for using shared equipment in a makerspace

options.name: Scheduled Time Slots with Usage Logs
options.upside: Ensures fair access and accountability through scheduled use and logs.
options.concern: May limit spontaneous use and requires users to consistently log usage.

options.name: First-Come, First-Served with Mandatory Safety Training
options.upside: Allows flexible access while promoting safety through required training.
options.concern: Could lead to equipment conflicts during busy times without reservations.

options.name: Point-Based Reservation System with Maintenance Duties
options.upside: Balances access and maintenance by incentivizing upkeep through points.
options.concern: Requires tracking points and may complicate access for casual users.

options.name: Open Access with Weekly Equipment Inspection Rotations
options.upside: Provides flexible use with regular maintenance to ensure safety.
options.concern: Relies on user participation in inspections and may risk equipment misuse.

shared_context: The makerspace has six regular users who need to agree on rules for using shared equipment. The rules should ensure fair access, safety, and maintenance responsibilities while accommodating different project needs.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a mechanical engineer who values hands-on experience and safety.
personas.private_goal: Ensure flexible access while maintaining equipment safety and upkeep.

A.reason_for: Scheduled slots ensure fair access and accountability, which supports safety.
A.reason_against: May limit spontaneous creativity and slow down urgent work.

B.reason_for: Mandatory safety training is crucial for preventing accidents.
B.reason_against: Open access could cause conflicts and equipment misuse.

C.reason_for: Points system encourages maintenance and fair use.
C.reason_against: Tracking points may complicate usage and reduce spontaneity.

D.reason_for: Open access with weekly inspections balances flexibility with safety and maintenance.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a software developer who prefers structured and accountable environments.
personas.private_goal: Maximize fairness and accountability in equipment use without sacrificing access.

A.reason_for: Pre-booked slots and usage logs ensure fairness and accountability.

B.reason_for: Safety training is important and open access allows flexibility.
B.reason_against: Lack of reservations may cause conflicts during busy times.

C.reason_for: Points incentivize maintenance and balance access fairly.

D.reason_for: Flexible use with scheduled inspections can maintain safety.
D.reason_against: Depends on consistent user participation for inspections.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a hobbyist who values ease of access and minimal bureaucracy.
personas.private_goal: Keep equipment use simple and accessible without too many rules.

A.reason_for: Scheduled slots provide fairness and accountability.

B.reason_for: Open access with safety training allows flexible and safe use.

C.reason_against: Too complex and restrictive for casual users.

D.reason_for: Flexible use with regular inspections helps maintain safety.
D.reason_against: Relies on user participation for inspections.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a product designer who balances structure with flexibility.
personas.private_goal: Ensure safety and fair access while allowing creative freedom.

A.reason_for: Scheduled slots and logs promote fairness and accountability.
A.reason_against: Booking may limit spontaneous project work.

B.reason_for: Safety training combined with open access supports safety and flexibility.

D.reason_for: Open access with inspections balances flexibility and safety.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is an artist who prioritizes creative freedom and community responsibility.
personas.private_goal: Maintain a collaborative environment with flexible access and shared upkeep.

A.reason_for: Scheduled use and logs ensure fairness and accountability.

B.reason_for: Safety training is important and open access supports creativity.

C.reason_against: Too complicated and may reduce community spirit.

D.reason_for: Open access with inspection rotations encourages freedom and shared responsibility.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a retired engineer who values clear rules and safety above all.
personas.private_goal: Ensure equipment is used safely and maintained properly with minimal hassle.

A.reason_for: Scheduled slots and logs promote safety and accountability.

C.reason_against: Too complex and difficult to manage.

D.reason_for: Open access with weekly inspections balances safety and ease of use.
